snippet.title: HorrorToleranceTest – Terrifying Triple-Threat Horror Challenge | PC Gameplay No Commentary
snippet.description:
HorrorToleranceTest  | 1080p 60FPS Raw Gameplay | No Commentary

🕹️ About Game:
Push your fear threshold to the limit in HorrorToleranceTest! This chilling horror game dares you to conquer three distinct terrifying experiences: "Surprise Horror," "Hide Horror," and "Escape Horror." Before diving in, a unique ability test evaluates your judgment, memory, and observation skills, adjusting the game’s difficulty to keep you on edge. Explore a haunted mansion to exorcise ghosts, hide from grotesque creatures in an overrun hospital, and overcome paralyzing fear to escape a nightmarish school. Perfect for horror fans craving a heart-pounding, mind-bending challenge!
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
🕹️ Game Details:
Developer: うさうさはっぴーげーむず
Publisher: うさうさはっぴーげーむず
Release Date: 19 Aug, 2025
Genre: Horror, Action
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
PC Requirements:

Minimum:
Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
OS: Windows 11
Processor: Intel Core i7-9700K
Memory: 16 GB RAM
Graphics: GeForce RTX 2070 SUPER
Storage: 8 GB available space

Recommended:
Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
